title: 17 Day Uganda Birding Safari
rank_math_title: Uganda Birding Safari: 17 Amazing Days from Nile to Bwindi
rank_math_desc: Uganda birding safari for 17 days: Mabamba shoebill, Murchison Falls, Budongo, Kibale, Semliki, Queen Elizabeth, Bwindi and Lake Mburo. Price on request.
post_content: This Uganda birding safari is a classic 17-day loop that takes in the shoebill, the Nile, five great forests and the Albertine Rift endemics.
overview:
This Uganda birding safari is designed for birders who want Uganda's full range in one trip. It starts with the shoebill at Mabamba, heads north to Murchison Falls and Budongo, then sweeps through the western forests to Bwindi and back via Lake Mburo.

Uganda packs more than 1,000 bird species into a small country. This route visits savannah, papyrus, lowland rainforest and montane forest, which is why lists of 450 species or more are common.

Why choose this Uganda birding safari?

  • Mabamba Swamp: a boat trip for the shoebill.
  • Murchison Falls: standard-winged nightjar, rock pratincole and a night drive.
  • Budongo and the Royal Mile: Puvel's illadopsis, Nahan's francolin and Ituri batis.
  • Kibale and Semliki: chimpanzees, pittas and Congo Basin specials.
  • Bwindi and Ruhija: African green broadbill, regal sunbird and an optional gorilla trek.

Where you stay

Resort Beach Hotel in Entebbe, Paraa Safari Lodge, Masindi Hotel, Ndali Lodge, Semliki Safari Lodge, Mountains of the Moon Hotel, Mweya Safari Lodge, Gorilla Forest Camp, a lodge at Ruhija and Mantana Tented Camp, or similar.

Best time for a Uganda birding safari

You can bird Uganda all year. June to August and December to February are drier, which makes forest trails easier. The wet months bring breeding plumage and fewer visitors.

Read our Uganda national parks guide and Bwindi gorilla trekking guide, or browse all Uganda safaris. The Uganda Wildlife Authority issues permits for every park on this route.

faq.q: Where is the best place to see a shoebill?
faq.a: Mabamba Swamp near Entebbe is one of the most reliable sites, and Murchison Falls is another good chance.

faq.q: How fit do I need to be?
faq.a: Moderate fitness is enough for most trails. Optional gorilla trekking and some Ruhija trails are steeper.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.content: Airport pick-up and optional birding in the Entebbe Botanical Gardens for turacos and palm-nut vultures. Overnight at Resort Beach Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Mabamba Swamp
itinerary.content: A boat trip through Mabamba's papyrus channels for the shoebill, papyrus gonolek and goliath heron. Return to Entebbe.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Entebbe to Murchison Falls
itinerary.content: Drive north with birding stops. Evening night drive for nightjars. Overnight at Paraa Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Murchison Falls National Park
itinerary.content: A full day in the savannah and woodland for ground hornbills, secretary birds, bustards and eagles.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Budongo Forest
itinerary.content: Bird the Kaniyo Pabidi section of Budongo for Puvel's illadopsis, crested guineafowl and white-thighed hornbill. Overnight at Masindi Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: The Royal Mile
itinerary.content: A full day on the Royal Mile for Nahan's francolin, kingfishers and forest flycatchers. Overnight at Masindi Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Masindi to Kibale
itinerary.content: Drive south along the Rift escarpment to Ndali Lodge near Kibale.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Kibale chimpanzees and birds
itinerary.content: Chimpanzee tracking and forest birding, with an optional night walk.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Kibale to Semliki
itinerary.content: Drive to Semliki for Congo Basin forest birds and the hot springs. Overnight at Semliki Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Semliki to Fort Portal
itinerary.content: Early birding on the Kirumia trail, then drive to Mountains of the Moon Hotel in Fort Portal.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Queen Elizabeth National Park
itinerary.content: Game drive in the Kasenyi plains and a launch trip on the Kazinga Channel. Overnight at Mweya Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 12
itinerary.title: Ishasha to Bwindi
itinerary.content: Drive through Ishasha to Buhoma and start your forest birding. Overnight at Gorilla Forest Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 13
itinerary.title: Bwindi forest or gorilla trek
itinerary.content: Forest birding on the Buhoma trails, or an optional gorilla trek.

itinerary.label: Day 14
itinerary.title: The Neck to Ruhija
itinerary.content: Bird the Neck for twinspots and bush-shrikes on the way up to Ruhija.

itinerary.label: Day 15
itinerary.title: Ruhija high forest
itinerary.content: Bamboo and montane forest birding for crimsonwings, regal sunbird and Lagden's bush-shrike.

itinerary.label: Day 16
itinerary.title: Ruhija to Lake Mburo
itinerary.content: Drive to Lake Mburo for savannah and wetland birds. Overnight at Mantana Tented Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 17
itinerary.title: Lake Mburo to Entebbe
itinerary.content: Morning birding at Lake Mburo, then drive to Entebbe via the equator for your flight.
